theorems.name: Submission.lip_approx_tangent_structure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight ∧ (∀ (T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (K : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn (fun x => hsNormSq (V.tangentProj x - T.starProjection)) K V.weight) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, (∃ T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ T = n ∧ V.tangentProj x = T.starProjection) ∧ V.HasDensity x (V.mult x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
